text:
This looks like a period of rising inflation, a rising policy rate, and a rising 2-year yield. The policy rate is low relative to its own 3-year average (z -1.0), yet it is up over 3m and 12m, which points to early in a hiking cycle. CPI z of +2.5 is high, with a 12m change of +2.5, so inflation has surged over the past year. Unemployment is low and falling, and the dollar is strong and rising.

The best fit is early-to-mid 2022 or late 2016/2017, but CPI at +2.5 favors 2022. Candidates are about March 2022, when the policy rate was only just lifting off, and the 2-year yield had risen sharply. In March 2022 the 3m change in the 2-year would be very large (+1.5 plausible), and the 10y-2y spread change of -2.0 fits. The VIX at -0.5, though, is odd for March 2022. Credit spreads at -1.0 and equities up 0.5 over 12m also fit early 2022 less well, though the 3-year window still includes the low-vol 2021.

Alternative: early 2005 is outside the range. Early 2022 with the dollar rising also fits. Industrial production +1.0 fits 2022. Treasuries 12m at -1.5 fits too. Equities 3m at +0.5 and 1m at +0.5 fit March 2022 (the S&P rallied in March) better than January or February. Developed ex-US +1.0 for 1m also fits March. Gold 1m at +0.5 and 12m at -1.0 is consistent with that too. I'll go with March 2022.
